sources.title: National planning policy for waste
sources.facts: Sets planning policy and locational criteria; policy is not a site permission.
sources.origin: Official UK government, regulator or national-statistics publication accessed 2026-07-30.
sources.guard: Waste policies, hierarchy guidance, permit collections and compliance-scoring methods do not by themselves prove a specific site has planning permission, an environmental permit, available capacity, completed recovery or compliant operations.
